description: Entity schema for chemistry — molecules, reactions, functional groups, catalysts, and solvents

Molecule.description: A chemical compound defined by its composition and structure

Reaction.description: A chemical transformation between reactants and products

FunctionalGroup.description: A specific group of atoms within a molecule responsible for characteristic chemical behavior

Catalyst.description: A substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without being consumed

Solvent.description: A liquid medium that dissolves reactants and enables chemical reactions

participates_in.description: A molecule acts as a reactant or product in a reaction

catalyzes.description: A catalyst accelerates a specific reaction

contains.description: A molecule contains a specific functional group

dissolved_in.description: A molecule is dissolved in a solvent

produced_by.description: A molecule is produced by a reaction

requires.description: A reaction requires a specific solvent for the medium
